attempts.summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified crond is enabled/active, the cron entry is installed, and the job executes correctly and logs output. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed a changed boot_id, and verified crond/cron entry/script/log all recovered healthy with a successful post-restart execution.
